outsiders.hook: Critical thinking when agents do the work.
outsiders.draft_en: When agents start doing the work, the job shifts: you stop producing and start judging. This piece walks through the checks that keep that judgment sharp - which tools to trust, what context to hand over, how to shape prompts, and how to tell good output from smooth output.

This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
